not_a_dopateam_mapping: 68 cortical plus 14 subcortical regions is an anatomical set. It does not verify the ordering or identity of DopaTeam synthetic r01 through r82.
alignment_limit: The cortical and subcortical assets share the FreeSurfer fsaverage surface-RAS frame. They are public template representations, not an exact jointly reconstructed patient brain. Source surface revisions are not geometrically identical.
